note: v2 calibration corpus. Independent from v1: documents, queries, expectations and scoring are bound together. 5 topic families; calibration scope is 4 families (retrieval_core, memory_lifecycle, challenge, schema_persistence); held-out scope is 1 family (search_operators). v1 is preserved unchanged at bench/corpus/v1/ with its original MANIFEST.json hashes. Both MANIFESTs are content-hashed; any change to a corpus file is detected at load time. Labels are scored against the v2 corpus's own documents, never against live-memory content.
